note: The bid-tab basis and the bid overlay over our direct cost (D-1273, revising D-1103). Every percentage is an input: intelcost-infra/bidtabs/basis-report.mjs reads this file and nothing in the script repeats a figure. No tab figure lives here. D-1287 (Rerun 2, Q13): the basis adds the sales tax on equipment rental at 8.25 % (Houston, D-1139; Texas taxes the contractor on rentals even for an exempt owner, 34 TAC §3.294(e)) and the damage waiver at 12 % (the company default; Q13). contract-runner.js reads both from its context (rentalTaxPct, waiverPct), set from basis.equipmentRentalTaxPct and basis.damageWaiverPct here.

basis.escalationNote: Tabs are compared as bid. No ECI escalation (D-1103's escalation is withdrawn).
basis.recentNote: The tuning set: tabs bid within this many months of the newest tab's bid month (bid month >= newest month - recentMonths). Older tabs are reported as history only.
basis.biddersNote: Every bidder on the tab, each priced on the same pay items as ours.
basis.labourNote: Labour at the tab's bid-date prevailing rates: the run's open-shop labour x the contract's labour ratio (D-1103, unchanged).
basis.salesTaxNote: MUD water, sewer and drainage tabs: no sales tax on material. The comparison carries none.
basis.tabNote: Every bidder's unit price on each pay item: tab-prices.mjs (the text layer; a figure split after its decimal point read whole), with the rows tab-rows-reread.py re-read word by word put in place where it recovered every bidder, each unit price paired with its total.
basis.equipmentRentalTaxNote: Sales tax on equipment rental, Texas (34 TAC §3.294): on each line's rentals' taxable part (the rent, the damage waiver, the dealer's fees and delivery), never owned hours, fuel, an operated hire on one rate or a third-party haul; the MUD's material exemption does not reach it. The runner folds it into the line's equipment: the contractor's cost, marked up as equipment.
basis.damageWaiverNote: The damage waiver on rentals, the company default (12 %, Q13 of D-1284): the throwaway project's own setting for the pass. The environmental fee runs at its default (1.3 %, capped at $75 a line).

excludeFromTuning.why: Temporary low-water-crossing culvert, removed at the end of construction: removal is not modelled (D-1272 item 11).
Temporary low-water-crossing culvert, removed at the end of construction: removal is not modelled (D-1272 item 11).

overlay.addNothingNote: Already in our direct cost (the crews, the spreads and their minimums).

indirects.separatelyPaidNote: Bonds, staking, SWPPP, silt fence, traffic control, dewatering and trench safety are paid as their own pay items where the tab lists them: no overlay is added for them on the pipe items.

ohp.note: One markup layer: Div 01 and OH&P inside the unit prices.

overlay.formula: L' = L x (1 + supervision + small tools); E' = E x (1 + supervision); bid = (L' x (1 + OH&P labour) + E' x (1 + OH&P equipment) + M x (1 + OH&P material) + S x (1 + OH&P subcontract)) / (1 - GL insurance - bond)

calibration.method: least squares on the log ratio, one point per contract: ln k = mean over contracts of ln(target / our direct); the $-weighted ratio (sum target / sum direct) beside it
calibration.healthyNote: Healthy is a multiplier on our direct of 1.20-1.35 to the medians (direct about 75-83 % of the median). The overlay's bid / direct is its own result, not a target. There is no band.
calibration.founderExpectation: A market-level direct sits about 23-25 % below the median bid.
